query: Current official France or European guideline for gestational trophoblastic disease oncology, including INCa, French reference centre, ESMO or ESGO, verify publication date and canonical URL
response:
## Current authoritative guideline identified

The most current official European guidance located is:

**Lok C, van Trommel N, Braicu EI, et al. _Practical Guidelines for the Treatment of Gestational Trophoblastic Disease: Collaboration of the European Organisation for the Treatment of Trophoblastic Disease (EOTTD)–European Society of Gynaecologic Oncology (ESGO)–Gynecologic Cancer InterGroup (GCIG)–International Society for the Study of Trophoblastic Diseases (ISSTD)._ Journal of Clinical Oncology. 2025;43(18):2119–2128. DOI: 10.1200/JCO-24-02326.**  
Primary publication/canonical DOI URL: **https://doi.org/10.1200/JCO-24-02326**  
Publisher page: **https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO-24-02326**  
Official ESGO guideline page: **https://www.esgo.org/eottd-esgo-gcig-isstd-practical-guidelines-for-the-treatment-of-gtd/**  
[Journal of Clinical Oncology](https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO-24-02326); [ESGO](https://www.esgo.org/eottd-esgo-gcig-isstd-practical-guidelines-for-the-treatment-of-gtd/)

### Publication date verification

- **Online publication:** **13 May 2025**, reported by the official EOTTD site and the PubMed bibliographic record. [EOTTD](https://eottd.org/); [PubMed PMID 40359461](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40359461/)
- **Issue publication:** **20 June 2025**, volume 43, issue 18, pages 2119–2128. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40359461/); [JCO](https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO-24-02326)

The two dates are not contradictory: 13 May is the advance online publication date, while 20 June is the dated journal issue. The DOI URL is the most stable canonical citation.

## Authority and source classification

| Source | Status | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| [JCO guideline article](https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO-24-02326) | **Primary** | The guideline itself; highest-authority source for recommendations and methods. |
| [Official ESGO guideline page](https://www.esgo.org/eottd-esgo-gcig-isstd-practical-guidelines-for-the-treatment-of-gtd/) | **Primary organizational source** | Confirms ESGO’s official publication/hosting of the joint guideline. |
| [Official EOTTD site](https://eottd.org/) | **Primary organizational source** | States that the joint guideline was published on 13 May 2025. |
| [PubMed record](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40359461/) | **Secondary bibliographic source** | Independently verifies authorship, DOI, online date, issue date, volume and pages, but is not the guideline text itself. |
| News summaries or clinical commentary | **Secondary** | Useful for orientation only; they should not replace the guideline article. |

The article describes itself as the first global consensus-based practical guideline for gestational trophoblastic disease and was produced jointly by EOTTD, ESGO, GCIG and ISSTD; ESGO supplied methodological/project support. [JCO](https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO-24-02326)

## France, INCa, French reference centre, and ESMO

From the authoritative records retrieved, I could **verify the 2025 joint EOTTD–ESGO–GCIG–ISSTD guideline**, but I could not verify a newer or equivalent dedicated guideline issued separately by **INCa**, the **French national reference centre**, or **ESMO**. Absence from the retrieved records should not be interpreted as proof that no French protocol, referral document, or older recommendation exists.

Accordingly, for a current citable European oncology guideline, use the **2025 JCO joint guideline** and its DOI as the canonical reference. Any French institutional protocol should be checked directly against the current INCa or French reference-centre document repository before being presented as the national guideline.

Ngan HYS. The practicability of FIGO 2000 staging for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Int J Gynecol Cancer 2004;14:202-205. The FIGO 2000 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) staging and classification has recommended three major changes in the management of GTN. The criteria for diagnosis of GTN following molar pregnancy were defined. The methods used for investigation of spread of the disease were recommended. A major change in the concept of FIGO staging in adding risk scoring to anatomical staging is novel but considered essential to best reflect the behavior of this disease which is different from other solid tumors. The history of evolution of this staging and classification system and practical points in applying this system were discussed. Previous article in issue

sources.snippet:
Ngan HYS. The practicability of FIGO 2000 staging for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Int J Gynecol Cancer 2004;14:202-205. The FIGO 2000 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) staging and classification has recommended three major changes in the management of GTN. The criteria for diagnosis of GTN following molar pregnancy were defined. The methods used for investigation of spread of the disease were recommended. A major change in the concept of FIGO staging in adding risk scoring to anatomical staging is novel but considered essential to best reflect the behavior of this disease which is different from other solid tumors. The history of evolution of this staging and classification system and practical points in applying this system were discussed. Previous article in issue
